title: Custom photo cake pickup for Merrylands and Westmead families
summary:
Sent a reference photo and still worried it won't look the same on the cake? That's the question we hear most in Harris Park.

The photo cake add-on is $19.99 — any of our 15 flavours, six sizes, printed to match exactly what you send. Not a filter. Not an approximation. The same image, on the cake.

We've done these for Merrylands birthdays and Westmead baby showers, and the design matches every time — because that's the only version we'd put our name on.

48 hours minimum notice. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. Pickup from Wigram Street, open until 10pm daily.
keywords: worried the cake won't match the reference photo
